settings.title: Global Settings
settings.headerDesc: Configure your Twitch, YouTube, and Spotify credentials.
settings.twitchAppHelpTitle: 💡 How to create your Twitch Dev App & get a Token:
settings.twitchAppHelp1: 1. Go to dev.twitch.tv/console/apps and create an application.
settings.twitchAppHelp2: 2. Add http://localhost as an OAuth Redirect URL in the Twitch console.
settings.twitchAppHelpWarning: Enter your Client ID above first to generate the URL.
settings.twitchAppHelpMsgTitle: ℹ️ Once the URL is open:
settings.twitchAppHelpMsgDescPart2: Copy the access_token value from the redirect URL and paste it in the Access Token field above.
settings.twitchAppHelp3: 3. The bot will connect automatically using this Access Token!
settings.spotifyHelp1: 1. Go to developer.spotify.com/dashboard and create an application.
settings.spotifyHelp2: 2. In your Spotify application settings, add this exact URL in Redirect URIs:
settings.spotifyHelp3: 3. Save changes on Spotify, paste your Client ID and Client Secret above, then click Connect!
settings.twitchIdHelpOpt1Desc: Enter your channel name on this website to get your numeric ID.
settings.twitchIdHelpInfo: The Broadcaster ID is a unique numeric ID required for EventSub.
settings.youtubeHelp1: 1. Go to console.cloud.google.com and create a project.
settings.youtubeHelp2: 2. Enable "YouTube Data API v3" in the API Library.
settings.youtubeHelp3: 3. In Credentials, create an API Key and paste it above.
settings.youtubeHelp4: 4. Copy your YouTube Channel ID (UCxxxxxxxx format) from YouTube advanced settings.
settings.youtubeHelp5: 5. Once configured, start your YouTube stream and click Connect!

youtube.title: YouTube Chat Overlay
youtube.instructionDesc: For YouTube, integration is done directly via the official live chat URL. Your API quotas are preserved and chat remains perfectly synced.
youtube.step1Title: Create a Browser Source in OBS
youtube.step1Desc:
In the "URL" field, paste the standard pop-out chat URL from your YouTube stream.
Example: https://www.youtube.com/live_chat?is_popout=1&v=YOUR_VIDEO_ID
youtube.step2Desc: Go to the "Customize" section to adjust colors, fonts, and borders. Then copy the generated "OBS CSS" code and paste it into your browser source's "Custom CSS" field.
youtube.step3Desc: The chat will instantly become transparent with your custom styling.
youtube.cssObsDesc: Copy this code and paste it into the "Custom CSS" field of your YouTube Chat browser source in OBS.
